The [[Uba system/Legends|Uba system's]] '''asteroid belt''' was the scattered remains of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uba III]], which was ripped apart when a [[Superweapon/Legends|weapons]] stockpile detonated during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Bombardment of the Uba system]].
